contracts.contract_plain_english: In one spatial dimension, an m-component unknown q : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ^m and a constant real m × m matrix A define the homogeneous first-order constant-coefficient linear system q_t(x,t) + A q_x(x,t) = 0, with subscripts denoting partial derivatives. [E1,E2,E3,E4,E5] The equation alone is not automatically hyperbolic: that designation additionally requires A to have real eigenvalues and m linearly independent corresponding eigenvectors. [E6] The cited statement supplies no initial data, boundary data, formal regularity class, or explicit point quantifier. [E7]
